controls.finding: Python json.loads uses last-wins object semantics unless duplicate keys are explicitly detected; integrity-critical candidate, manifest and member JSON currently use plain json.loads.
checks: record offending JSON path and key

controls.finding: Python's default JSON decoder accepts NaN and Infinity although RFC 8259 does not permit them.
checks: reject negative Infinity token during parse
require finite row counts and measurements

controls.finding: Candidate verifier checks confidence < 96 but does not first require math.isfinite or an upper bound; NaN can evade the less-than comparison.
checks: bind confidence to row parcel and HMLR identity
require numeric gate source confidence finite

controls.finding: The verifier checks only two substrings in served index.html and records its SHA; it does not prove the served index equals the current local worktree index.
checks: bind index SHA to accepted manifest SHA

controls.finding: Candidate expected_web_operation_rows and served manifest expectation are each checked only against a floor; equality between candidate, served manifest and current canonical expectation is not enforced.
checks: load current canonical expected row count
require served manifest expected count equality

controls.finding: Loopback verifier calls response.content/json without bounded streaming, so a malformed local resource can consume excessive memory before semantic checks.
checks: abort before JSON parse on overflow

controls.finding: JSON resources are parsed regardless of HTTP Content-Type; acceptance should prove the representation is served as JSON with interoperable UTF-8 bytes.
checks: require application/json or +json for JSON resources
bind media type to response SHA

controls.finding: EA GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage currently materialize response bodies before enforcing MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES.
checks: record response byte counts and hashes

controls.finding: Per-row output records resolved GetCoverage URL and GeoTIFF SHA but does not retain a canonical request receipt tying HMLR geometry SHA, bounds, padding and axis labels to the requested subsets.
checks: hash exact HMLR geometry per row
record axis labels from selected coverage envelope
bind request receipt to GeoTIFF SHA

controls.finding: Numeric gate checks that child scripts exist but does not hash them against the executable blob pins carried by the canonical task/status before subprocess execution.
checks: hash Terrain50 wrapper resolver and crosschecker

controls.finding: Wrapper consumes resolver manifest and archive_paths but final crosscheck payload does not bind the resolver-manifest SHA and selected download records into final provenance.
checks: bind OS product id and version
bind selected download metadata per required area
propagate resolver-manifest SHA to final crosscheck
block archive not present in accepted manifest

controls.finding: Crosschecker stores sampled values and a count but not the BNG coordinates/row-column identities of contributing cells, so duplicate cell contribution cannot be independently audited.
checks: derive BNG centre for every sampled raster cell
require unique coordinate identity across selected tiles
bind cell coordinate/value tuples to ASC SHA
record polygon-intersection role for all-touched sampling
derive statistics only from deduplicated cells

controls.finding: Required per-tile metadata XML references an external XSLT; the future metadata parser must not fetch external entities, schemas or stylesheets during verification.
checks: parse metadata XML with entity resolution disabled
disable network access in XML parser
record raw XML SHA before parse
extract only required local metadata fields
block parse requiring external network content

controls.finding: OS states the asc.aux.xml min/max/mean/stddev values are the same for every tile and exist for styling; they must never become tile or parcel elevation evidence.
checks: exclude its statistics from numeric crosscheck
never use aux min/max as tile extrema
bind numeric values only to selected ASC cells
allow aux SHA only as diagnostic provenance
add regression fixture against aux-value promotion
keep EA as primary numeric source

controls.finding: Matcher scans every Fiona layer and accepts a broad identifier match; the selected feature should be bound to the intended current INSPIRE Index Polygon feature/layer schema, not merely an exact-looking ID in another layer.
checks: record source layer and feature type
require Land Registry-INSPIRE ID field equivalence
bind layer schema to authority GML SHA
bind feature to current INSPIRE Index Polygon dataset family
